items.source: The name of the property SDN uses to transport relationship types.
items.translation: SDN 用于传输关系类型的属性名称。

items.source: A relationship is dynamic when it's modelled as a Map<String, ?>.
items.translation: 当关系被建模为 `Map<String, ?>` 时，它是动态的。

items.source: Returns true if updates should be cascaded along this relationship.
items.translation: 如果更新应沿此关系级联，则返回 true。

items.source: Returns the logically same relationship definition in the target entity.
items.translation: 在目标实体中返回逻辑上相同的关联关系定义。

items.source:
If this is a relationship with properties, the properties-defining class will get
returned, otherwise null.
items.translation: 如果这是一个具有属性的关系，将返回定义该属性的类；否则返回 null。

items.source:
The source of this relationship is described by the primary label of the node in
question.
items.translation: 该关系来源由问题中节点的主标签描述。

items.source:
If this relationship is dynamic, then this method always returns the name of the
inverse property.
items.translation: 如果这种关系是动态的，那么此方法始终返回逆属性的名称。

items.source:
Checks if there is a relationship description describing the obverse of this
relationship.
items.translation: 检查是否存在描述该关系正面的关系说明。

items.source:
Set the relationship definition that describes the opposite side of the
relationship.
items.translation: 设置描述关系相反侧的关系定义。

items.source: Description of a relationship. Those descriptions always describe outgoing relationships. The inverse direction is maybe defined on the NodeDescription reachable in the Schema via it's primary label defined by getTarget().
items.translation: 关系的描述。这些描述总是针对出向关系。反向方向可能在通过其由 `getTarget()` 定义的主标签可达的 `Schema` 中的 `NodeDescription` 上定义。

items.source: The target of this relationship is described by the primary label of the node in question. If the relationship description includes a relationship properties class, this will be the NodeDescription of the TargetNode.
items.translation: 该关系的目标由问题节点的初级标签描述。如果关系描述中包含关系属性类，则这将是 NodeDescription 的 TargetNode。

items.source: Tells if this relationship is a relationship with additional properties. In such cases getRelationshipPropertiesClass will return the type of the properties holding class.
items.translation: 判断此关系是否为具有附加属性的关系。在此类情况下，getRelationshipPropertiesClass 将返回持有属性类的类型。

items.source: The direction of the defined relationship.
items.translation: 定义关系的方向。

items.source: The name of the property where the relationship was defined.
items.translation: 定义该关系的属性名称。

items.source:
The target of this relationship is described by the primary label of the node in
question.
items.translation: 该关系的目标由问题中节点的初级标签描述。

items.source: Tells if this relationship is a relationship with additional properties.
items.translation: 指示此关系是否为具有附加属性的关系。

items.source:
The name of the property where the relationship was defined. This is used by the
Cypher creation to name the return values.
items.translation: 定义关系的属性名称。Cypher 创建使用此名称来命名返回值。

items.source:
The direction of the defined relationship. This is used by the Cypher creation to
query for relationships and create them with the right directions.
items.translation: 定义的关系的方向。Cypher 创建使用此属性来查询关系并以正确的方向创建它们。

items.source: relationshipObverse - logically same relationship definition in the target entity
items.translation: relationshipObverse - 目标实体中逻辑上相同的反向关系定义

items.translation: 具有属性的关系的关系属性类的类型，否则为 null。

false

true if a logically same relationship in the target entity exists,
otherwise false.
